title: CSTD global-property hook inert on Zephyr 4.1.0; c23 is not a compile-features id
description: lichen zephyr CMake sets GLOBAL PROPERTY CSTD with no reader in zephyr 4.1.0 (dialect comes from CONFIG_STD_*); only the v3.7.x line reads it; also 'c23' is not a valid compile-features id (c2x/gnu2x). Guard with version check or document v3.7-pin-only.
close_reason: lichen/zephyr/CMakeLists.txt: set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY CSTD c2x) unconditionally, dead LICHEN_C_DIALECT variable removed, probe kept as configure-time C23 guard with honest comment: v3.7.0 (west.yml pin) reads the property at zephyr/CMakeLists.txt:1000-1010 (verified on AWS v3.7.0 tree: value feeds ${compile_features_${CSTD}} and -std=${CSTD}; only c90/c99/c11/c17/c2x spellings valid, 'c23' would break SDK GCC12); Zephyr 4.1.0 has no reader (grep verified) so inert there. Verified: v3.7.0 build compiles LICHEN TUs with -std=c2x (visible on gcc command lines in b64_linkcrypto), configure prints 'LICHEN: using -std=c2x', link_crypto 18/18 PASS.
